question: Do strong current lithium pricing/earnings and slower BEV growth plus production flexibility form an unresolved material contradiction?
whyItMatters: The routing queue assigns Resolver ownership even though current Beta evidence explicitly marks the contradiction resolved and non-gating.
lawfulFallbacks: Retain commodity-cycle and demand-absorption uncertainty for Council Alpha underwriting.
Reopen only on materially new evidence establishing mutually exclusive claims or present impairment.
successCondition: Bound the contradiction while preserving cycle uncertainty and root-owner underwriting authority.

adjudication.finding: Strong realized pricing/earnings can coexist with slower BEV growth and production flexibility. Current Beta evidence explicitly resolves the tension: it limits mechanical extrapolation but does not establish present impairment because BESS and other demand can offset mix changes.
adjudication.remainingUncertainty: Normalized full-cycle pricing/margins, cost-curve position, project funding burden and demand durability remain underwriting questions for Council Alpha.
adjudication.directive: Deterministic reconciliation should consume this Resolver disposition for unresolved_material_contradiction on t0:SQM while retaining commodity-cycle risks.

antiRepeat.changedStrategy: Relied on the latest explicit Beta resolved/non-gating disposition rather than duplicating source acquisition.
